LESSON: KUANDIKA 1.3.1 VIAKIFISHI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua alama ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini
2. kueleza matumizi ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini
3. kutumia alama ya koloni na semi koloni ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua alama ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua alama ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kueleza matumizi ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza matumizi ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia alama ya koloni na semi koloni ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia alama ya koloni na semi koloni ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua alama ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua alama ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini
2. kueleza matumizi ya koloni na semi koloni katika matini
3. kutumia alama ya koloni na semi koloni ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
